question: Median package of Electronics and Communication in 200220244 batch
sql: WITH ordered AS (SELECT o.ctc_lpa, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY o.ctc_lpa) AS r, COUNT(*) OVER () AS c FROM offers AS o JOIN students AS s ON o.student_id = s.student_id JOIN branches AS b ON s.branch_code = b.branch_code WHERE b.short_name = 'ECE' AND s.batch_id = '2020-2024' AND NOT o.ctc_lpa IS NULL AND o.offer_type IN ('FTE', 'PPO', 'Intern+PPO', 'Intern+FTE')) SELECT ROUND(AVG(ctc_lpa), 2) AS median_ctc FROM ordered WHERE r IN ((c + 1) / 2, (c + 2) / 2);

question: names of those
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT p.full_name, b.short_name, s.batch_id, c.canonical_name, 
               COALESCE(o.profile, 'Graduate Engineer / Analyst') AS role, o.offer_type
        FROM offers o
        JOIN students s ON o.student_id = s.student_id
        JOIN student_private_pii p ON s.student_id = p.student_id
        JOIN branches b ON s.branch_code = b.branch_code
        JOIN companies c ON o.company_id = c.company_id
        WHERE o.offer_type IN ('FTE', 'PPO', 'Intern+PPO', 'Intern+FTE') AND c.canonical_name LIKE ? AND b.short_name LIKE ? AND s.batch_id = ?
        ORDER BY p.full_name ASC;

sql: SELECT c.canonical_name, MAX(o.ctc_lpa) AS max_ctc FROM offers AS o JOIN students AS s ON o.student_id = s.student_id JOIN branches AS b ON s.branch_code = b.branch_code JOIN companies AS c ON o.company_id = c.company_id WHERE b.division = 'Core' AND NOT o.ctc_lpa IS NULL AND o.offer_type IN ('FTE', 'PPO', 'Intern+PPO', 'Intern+FTE') GROUP BY c.canonical_name ORDER BY max_ctc DESC LIMIT 3;

question: names of those

assumptions: Across all batches 2020-24 to 2022-26, full-time offers only

sql:
SELECT DISTINCT p.full_name, b.short_name, s.batch_id, c.canonical_name, 
               COALESCE(o.profile, 'Graduate Engineer / Analyst') AS role, o.offer_type
        FROM offers o
        JOIN students s ON o.student_id = s.student_id
        JOIN student_private_pii p ON s.student_id = p.student_id
        JOIN branches b ON s.branch_code = b.branch_code
        JOIN companies c ON o.company_id = c.company_id
        WHERE o.offer_type IN ('FTE', 'PPO', 'Intern+PPO', 'Intern+FTE') AND c.canonical_name LIKE ? AND b.short_name LIKE ? AND s.batch_id IN (?,?,?)
        ORDER BY p.full_name ASC;

question: name of ppl who got into IndiaMART in CSE

assumptions: Across all batches 2020-24 to 2022-26, full-time offers only

sql:
SELECT DISTINCT p.full_name, b.short_name, s.batch_id, c.canonical_name, 
               COALESCE(o.profile, 'Graduate Engineer / Analyst') AS role, o.offer_type
        FROM offers o
        JOIN students s ON o.student_id = s.student_id
        JOIN student_private_pii p ON s.student_id = p.student_id
        JOIN branches b ON s.branch_code = b.branch_code
        JOIN companies c ON o.company_id = c.company_id
        WHERE o.offer_type IN ('FTE', 'PPO', 'Intern+PPO', 'Intern+FTE') AND c.canonical_name LIKE ? AND b.short_name LIKE ? AND s.batch_id IN (?,?,?)
        ORDER BY p.full_name ASC;

question: name of ppl who got into IndiaMART in CSE

assumptions: Across all batches 2020-24 to 2022-26, full-time offers only

sql:
SELECT DISTINCT p.full_name, b.short_name, s.batch_id, c.canonical_name, 
               COALESCE(o.profile, 'Graduate Engineer / Analyst') AS role, o.offer_type
        FROM offers o
        JOIN students s ON o.student_id = s.student_id
        JOIN student_private_pii p ON s.student_id = p.student_id
        JOIN branches b ON s.branch_code = b.branch_code
        JOIN companies c ON o.company_id = c.company_id
        WHERE o.offer_type IN ('FTE', 'PPO', 'Intern+PPO', 'Intern+FTE') AND c.canonical_name LIKE ? AND b.short_name LIKE ? AND s.batch_id IN (?,?,?)
        ORDER BY p.full_name ASC;

        FROM offers o

sql: WITH ordered AS (SELECT o.ctc_lpa, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY o.ctc_lpa) AS r, COUNT(*) OVER () AS c FROM offers AS o JOIN students AS s ON o.student_id = s.student_id JOIN branches AS b ON s.branch_code = b.branch_code WHERE b.short_name = 'IT' AND s.batch_id = '2020-2024' AND NOT o.ctc_lpa IS NULL AND o.offer_type IN ('FTE', 'PPO', 'Intern+PPO', 'Intern+FTE')) SELECT ROUND(AVG(ctc_lpa), 2) AS median_ctc FROM ordered WHERE r IN ((c + 1) / 2, (c + 2) / 2);

sql: SELECT c.canonical_name, COUNT(o.offer_id) AS offers_count FROM offers AS o JOIN students AS s ON o.student_id = s.student_id JOIN companies AS c ON o.company_id = c.company_id JOIN branches AS b ON s.branch_code = b.branch_code WHERE b.short_name = 'CSE' AND o.offer_type IN ('FTE', 'PPO', 'Intern+PPO', 'Intern+FTE') GROUP BY c.canonical_name ORDER BY offers_count DESC, c.canonical_name ASC LIMIT 5;

assumptions: Across all batches 2020-24 to 2022-26, full-time offers only

sql:
SELECT DISTINCT p.full_name, b.short_name, s.batch_id, c.canonical_name, 
               COALESCE(o.profile, 'Graduate Engineer / Analyst') AS role, o.offer_type
        FROM offers o
        JOIN students s ON o.student_id = s.student_id
        JOIN student_private_pii p ON s.student_id = p.student_id
        JOIN branches b ON s.branch_code = b.branch_code
        JOIN companies c ON o.company_id = c.company_id

question: Names of students placed in Microsoft

assumptions: Across all batches 2020-24 to 2022-26, full-time offers only

sql:
SELECT DISTINCT p.full_name, b.short_name, s.batch_id, c.canonical_name, 
               COALESCE(o.profile, 'Graduate Engineer / Analyst') AS role, o.offer_type
        FROM offers o
        JOIN students s ON o.student_id = s.student_id
        JOIN student_private_pii p ON s.student_id = p.student_id
        JOIN branches b ON s.branch_code = b.branch_code
        JOIN companies c ON o.company_id = c.company_id
        WHERE o.offer_type IN ('FTE', 'PPO', 'Intern+PPO', 'Intern+FTE') AND c.canonical_name LIKE ? AND s.batch_id IN (?,?,?)
        ORDER BY p.full_name ASC;

question: Top 3 companies by highest monthly internship stipend

assumptions: Across all batches 2020-24 to 2022-26, full-time offers only

question: What is Microsoft's package?

assumptions: Across all batches 2020-24 to 2022-26, full-time offers only

sql: SELECT DISTINCT o.ctc_lpa FROM offers AS o JOIN students AS s ON o.student_id = s.student_id JOIN companies AS c ON o.company_id = c.company_id WHERE c.canonical_name = 'Microsoft' AND s.batch_id IN ('2020-2024', '2021-2025', '2022-2026') AND NOT o.ctc_lpa IS NULL ORDER BY o.ctc_lpa DESC LIMIT 100;
